description: Each ring of the circuit becomes a letter: an iridescent tube follows a glyph outline on black while the camera threads the word letter by letter, so reading it is a journey through the typography. The text is yours.

name: dragon-corridor-v3-grid
description: No corridor here: one frosted plate pierced by a grid of round holes seen from below, against a dark blue ground. A striped iridescent dragon pops out of one hole, arcs through the air and dives into another, glimpsed as a blur beneath.

name: rings-v3-letter-orbit
description: A single letter, shown as a thin iridescent tube on black, stands still in the middle of the frame while the camera walks slowly around it. Nothing rushes past, so the oil-slick colour is easy to read. The text is yours.

name: rings-v4-letter-morph
description: One iridescent glyph melts into the next letter of a word on black, the tube behaving as a single piece of liquid that reshapes itself and lands back on the first glyph as the loop closes. The text is yours.

name: rings-v5-constellation
description: The letters of a word float scattered through a 3D cloud as iridescent tubes on black, and the camera flies a smooth closed path through every one in word order. A scatter setting tidies the cloud back into a circuit.

name: flowers-shaders-v4-pearls
description: Glossy chrome spheres drop down the axis of a braid of iridescent pipes on black, and the braid bulges or pinches around each pearl as it passes, as if it pulled the tubes in.

name: braid-v6-interactive-ring
description: A woven knot of dark glossy rope with oil-slick sheen around a ring that you can bend: white handle points sit on its centreline and dragging them reshapes the loop, by mouse, touch or hand tracking. Black ground.

name: flowers-shaders-v5-orbit-pearls
description: Chrome pearls fall outside a braid of iridescent pipes on black, each orbiting at its own radius and corkscrewing around the structure, printing a travelling spiral wave onto the tubes as they pass.

name: rings-v6-letter-sculpt
description: One iridescent liquid letter on black that you deform by hand: every point of its outline can be pulled with a mouse, a finger or a camera-tracked pinch, and the tube re-fuses around wherever you leave it. No automatic motion.

name: rings-v7-hyper-interactive
description: A liquid iridescent letter on black, deformed by a troupe of drawn cursors that walk on from off-canvas, share the outline's handles between them, drag them outward and retreat. You can still sculpt it by hand mid-show.

name: rings-v8-morph-hyper-interactive
description: A troupe of drawn cursors retypes a list of letters or words on black, physically dragging the iridescent tube of each text into the next. Each finished text holds legible before the conversion begins.

name: photo-swap-collage
description: Two photographs split the frame but trade places: each half wears an enlargement of the other, while a mirrored rectangle on each half shows the patch the opposite side hides. Clicking moves both windows at once. Pairs of photos take turns, on warm cream.

name: photo-trail-effect-v1
description: Ribbons of colour pulled out of the photo itself stream off to either side of the subject as if the picture's paint were dragged, passing behind it while a cut-out keeps the subject sharp on top. Draggable handles shape the ribbons; click the photo to pick the subject. Uses your photo.

name: photo-segmentation-v1-mask
description: A photograph where clicking a point lifts the subject off it: a segmentation model cuts out what you picked, which floats pin-sharp with a drop shadow over a blurred copy of the same scene. A koala photo is the default. Needs a photo.

name: photo-segmentation-v2-noise-reveal
description: A heavily blurred photograph in which regions snap into focus one after another, as a looping noise walk picks points and a segmentation model cuts out whatever sits there, a circle marking the pick. Clicks override it. Needs a photo.

name: rings-v9-flick-reveal
description: Drawn cursors pluck points of an iridescent liquid word on black, stretch them like elastics towards the canvas edge and let go, and each point springs across to its place in the next text. Several are in flight at once.

name: photo-trail-effect-v2-echo
description: A fan of ghost copies of the cut-out subject arcs along a draggable curve, each copy fainter and smaller, optionally rotated or tinted, while the real subject stays crisp on top. The photo behind can stay sharp, blur or dim. Uses your photo; click it to pick the subject.

name: rings-v10-magnetic-flyby
description: A formation of drawn cursors, by default a breathing circle of hands, flies over an iridescent liquid word on black without touching it; the letters lean toward each passing cursor and settle like jelly. Plays soft sounds as they pass.

name: photo-stamp-collage
description: A photograph fills the lower half of a speckled warm-paper ground while a perforated white postage stamp above shows a magnified detail of it, and a stamp-shaped hole is punched out of the photo. Clicking the photo re-aims the stamp; clicking the paper moves it.

name: flip-v1-letter-cycle
description: A single glyph — a letter or a word from your list, drawn as a chain of iridescent tubes on black — turning on a horizontal or vertical axis; every time the plane passes edge-on the next entry takes over, so the cycle reads as a letter flipping into the next (a, b, c…). Chunky 3D lettering with a chrome ramp.

name: flip-v2-grid-cascade
description: A board of turning tiles on black, each tile carrying a glyph drawn as thin iridescent strokes: the turn is also what multiplies them — a tile goes edge-on and comes back as two, then four, then eight — in a cascade across the grid, before the board collapses back to one. Sparse, rhythmic, like a split-flap display.

name: flip-v3-tube-cascade
description: A black board of tiles, each carrying a single letter in a wavy typeface drawn as a thick tube in shifting spectral colour, so highlights slide along the letter as the tile turns. Tiles flip edge-on and return as two, splitting outward from the centre up to five levels, unevenly, before restarting.

name: vector3d-demo
description: A small lit scene on near-black: a pale sphere and a grey torus inside a wireframe box with a floor grid, and a white sun joined by a thin ray, seen by a camera that circles once per loop while the torus spins on a slanted axis.

name: sculpt-v1-scatter-lattice
description: A seeded cloud of chrome beads on black, joined by raymarched iridescent tubes that grow out along the links and withdraw again in a wave over the loop: the sculpture assembles, holds, then scatters back into loose beads. A pointer (or a virtual cursor) pulls the beads.

name: sculpt-v3-vision-relief
description: A tilted hexagonal sheet of small, widely spaced beads, each its own hue, lifts under a hand-shaped silhouette that circles it, with tubes joining the raised beads into a patch of mesh that relaxes after it passes. Turn on the camera and tracked hands and faces take over.

name: sculpt-v2-letter-relief
description: A tilted lattice sheet of small beads, seen in perspective, from which letters of a word rise one after another as a relief of fat iridescent beads and tubes, then sink back. Big, chunky, chrome-coloured typography on black.

name: sculpt-v4-sphere
description: A ball of iridescent beads, half on its surface and half inside, linked by tubes that grow outward from the centre once per loop with tapering tips, so the volume reads as solid rather than a hollow shell. The far side sinks into fog; a pointer pulls nearby beads.

name: sculpt-v5-letter-pinch
description: A coarse, irregular net of beads and tubes tilted across the frame, pulled inward by the letters of a word: points slide to each glyph's outline, so the mesh bunches and fuses into a lifted knot in the letter's shape, then squeezes on to the next. A pointer attracts the sheet.

name: sculpt-v6-letter-halftone
description: A halftone of letters on a dark grid of tiny beads: under each glyph of the word the dots swell into fat iridescent spheres that touch and read as the letter, the rest of the grid staying a faint dotted field; the word is spelt one letter per beat, each letter melting back before the next.

name: sculpt-v7-letter-slices
description: A sparse sheet of beads carrying a letter of raised, fused beads that never sits still: it is cut into strips that slide up and down past each other along a wave, so the glyph looks sliced and sheared. On each beat the strips slide out as the next letter's strips come in.

name: lcd-v1-flipper-zero
description: A 128 by 64 orange-backlit LCD of a pocket multi-tool in a dark bezel, cycling through its screens: an icon menu, a frequency analyzer, a signal capture, a card reader, a typed message with a blinking cursor and a dithered plasma. Dark square pixels dissolve from one screen to the next.

name: sculpt-v8-letter-dashes
description: A grid of short horizontal dashes covers the sheet like compass needles; near each letter they turn along the stroke, lengthen and merge into continuous ribbons while the counters stay open. At each beat the dashes swing round to the next letter. A pointer turns nearby dashes to face it.

name: sculpt-v9-letter-ripple
description: A dense tilted sheet of beads and thin tubes with a letter standing as a low plateau at its centre, from which ring-shaped crests spread outward, three per loop, raising and nudging the points as they pass. Each beat the plateau morphs to the next letter. The pointer adds rings.

name: iridescent-v1-peaks-sphere
description: A spiked ellipsoid — rings of solid petal-like spikes around a small body, like a sea urchin or a dahlia — turning slowly on a pale blue-grey ground, its surfaces coloured by an iridescent ramp (pink, cream, green, blue by default; a dozen named palettes) that shifts with the viewing angle as it rotates.

name: iridescent-v2-peaks-cylinder
description: An upright cylinder bristling with thick solid spikes, twelve around and twelve along, turning on a pale blue-grey ground. Bands of blue, green, cream and pink slide over each spike, whose lengths are nearly uniform, and they overlap into ridges.

name: iridescent-v3-peaks-tunnel
description: Seen from inside a tube that narrows into the distance, rings of solid spikes point inward and shrink to nothing at the far end. Bands of blue, green, cream and pink wrap each spike and fog fades the depth into the pale ground while the tunnel sways.

name: iridescent-v4-orbit-pearls
description: A tall twisted braid of four ribbon-like tubes filling the frame top to bottom, with small white pearls corkscrewing around it along the loop, raymarched on a pale blue-grey ground and coloured by the iridescent ramp (pink, cream, green, navy by default). Slow, glossy, jewel-like — and heavy to render.

name: iridescent-v5-spiral-bloom
description: A flower seen from above, its some two hundred flat, cupped petals packed on a golden-angle spiral like a dahlia or a sunflower head — short and upright at the heart, long and laid back at the rim. It closes and reopens in a wave running from the centre outwards while the spiral arms wind and unwind, and the iridescent ramp is staggered along the spiral so the hue itself draws the arms.

name: materials-v1-flame
description: A single tall flame on a near-black ground: a white-hot core inside orange tongues that curl upwards and tear off at the tip, a blue foot, a soft halo and sparks drifting up, all turning slowly like a small fire whirl in a seamless loop. Fire colours by default; a palette picker turns the same flame into other colours.

name: iridescent-v6-peaks-knot
description: A trefoil knot bristling with fine needles — a thin tube winding through itself, covered in rows of spikes of uneven length like a sea creature or a thorny vine — turning slowly on a pale blue-grey ground while the needles travel along the knot and roll around it. Surfaces are coloured by the iridescent ramp, which shifts with the viewing angle.

name: iridescent-v7-peaks-shell
description: A spiny seashell — a spiral tube that widens turn after turn from a fine apex to an open mouth, its outer side armed with needles gathered into three combs like a murex, hair-thin at the top and long at the bottom — turning slowly on a pale blue-grey ground while the spines sway in a wave. Surfaces are coloured by the iridescent ramp, which shifts with the viewing angle.

name: materials-v2-water
description: Open sea at golden hour, seen from just above the waves: a choppy swell rolling towards a warm horizon under a deep blue sky, the low sun laying a path of glitter across the water, the camera rising and swaying gently as on a boat. A calm, endless, seamless loop.

name: materials-v3-caustics
description: A swimming pool seen from straight above on a sunny day: a floor of turquoise tiles wobbling under the ripples, and over it the bright, shifting net of light the water casts, edged with faint rainbow fringes, with the odd glint of sun off the surface. Slow, cool and hypnotic, in a seamless loop.

name: materials-v4-sand
description: A sea of orange dunes under a low sun: long lit slopes, knife-edged crests and steep faces in violet shade receding to a hazy horizon, with veils of sand streaming over the slopes, plumes spilling off the crests and fine ripples creeping forward in the wind. Still, warm and slow, in a seamless loop.

name: materials-v5-ice
description: A faceted block of clear ice turning slowly against a dark blue backdrop: studio lights bent and broken through its facets, a milky heart of trapped air, bright fracture planes flashing as it turns, white edges and a blue that deepens with its thickness. Cold, sharp and glittering, in a seamless loop.

name: materials-v6-lava
description: A lake of lava at night, seen from just above it: dark plates of crust drifting on the melt, split by glowing orange cracks that widen, branch and close as waves of heat pass underneath, with sparks rising and the far shore lost in a red haze. Slow, heavy and incandescent, in a seamless loop.

name: materials-v7-smoke
description: A thread of pale smoke rising from a glowing ember in the dark: a smooth, slowly twisting ribbon that breaks into soft billows as it climbs, lit from the side so it has depth and shade, widening and thinning until it is gone. Quiet, slow and hypnotic, in a seamless loop.
